verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Facial Similarity reports compare live selfie/video/motion capture to the document portrait and describe liveness assessment via head-turn/motion challenges (docs-12, docs-18, docs-30), which directly supports selfie-to-document matching with liveness detection. However, there is no explicit documentation of specific anti-spoofing defenses against printed photos, screen replay, or video replay attacks, nor any independent/hands-on test evidence of liveness robustness. Missing for 10: explicit documented defenses against photo/screen/replay spoofing, independent test results or accuracy benchmarks, and detail on passive vs active liveness methods.
